title: I would like to be able to select a language in the date_input component
body: ### Checklist - [X] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests. - [X] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue. ### Summary I would like to be able to select a language in the date_input component. ### Why? I work at a Japanese company and our team provide an application created in Streamlit for internal use. There are many users in our company who can only read Japanese and not English, so many users are confused when selecting date in `st.date_input`. I think it would help a lot of users if we could not only allow them to choose in Japanese, but also to choose their language. ### How? Images : It's Japanese Image. code : ```python start_date: date = entry_form.date_input( "Enter Start Date", key="start_date", format="YYYY-MM-DD", language = 'ja' ) ``` ### Additional Context _No response_
